nom: Peter Thomas Roth Ultimate Solution 5 Multitasking Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the cream as rich, thick, and effective at hydrating the under-eye area, with one noting it works well but is too slippery to wear under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the product is gentle, fragrance-free or lightly scented, and does not irritate the eye area, including one case of contact dermatitis whose dryness and redness improved.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin, prone to milia from heavy creams, found this formula moisturizing without feeling too heavy and without triggering milia.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or mature note improvements in firmness, crepiness, and dark circles, though results on deep wrinkles are sometimes limited or partial.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, firmer skin and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles; a few note no visible change in wrinkles, including one 23-year-old who saw no difference specifically in wrinkles though other benefits occurred.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong hydration and plumping with regular use, sometimes noted the morning after; almost no dissent on this point.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the cream reduced dryness and redness from a contact dermatitis flare-up under the eyes.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically discuss barrier repair separate from general hydration.
concerns.spots: No reviews mention spots or discoloration outside of dark circles.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several say it caused no milia or breakouts, but one reviewer felt it clogged pores and caused a few zits, and another described a gritty texture causing hesitation despite no breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, milia-prone skin found the formula lightweight enough not to trigger issues; another described the texture as greasy and slow to absorb.

aspects.libelle: Greasy or heavy, slow to absorb
Too slippery for daytime makeup use

extraits.texte: I cant explain the gritty texturr as I thought maybe it was the product combination of things before the eye cream, but its not. It is a fine grit that literally only my undereyes feel. It weird. When I think of eye creams, I think rich, smooth, hydrating and this is not it. I wished it was based on its claims but won't be repurchasing. I wish I hadn't tossed the box because I would've returned it.

Im 37, trying to improve my dark circles and sunken eyes, from kids and poor sleep. I use this product nightly and it doesnt seem to do anything. It has a greasy texture and doesnt absorb well. It says to apply m twice a day but there's no way I would be able to apply this in the morning with my make up. Also, if you rub your eye or cry or somehow get any of this in your eye, it burns. I wouldn't buy this again.

This is thick and luxurious very very moisturizing! I have dry skin and have heavy under eye bags. I really do enjoy using this product but I would not recommend using it under makeup up its a little to slippery for me. I love it for night time! Gifted by peterthomasroth

extraits.titre: Helped with my undereye contact dermatitis
extraits.texte: I had a contact dermatitis flare up under my eyes, this cream (which i received as a sample) helped alleviate the dryness and redness of the rash. Will be purchasing it and adding it to my skin care routine!

This eye cream is very moisturizing but doesn't feel too heavy. My skin is oily and I have a tendency to get milia if creams are too thick, this ones been perfect so far! There little to no scent to it and it absorbs really nicely without feeling sticky/tacky. So far it's been very helpful with my puffy undereyes! Gifted by PeterThomasRoth

Am in my mid 50's with genetic VERY dark circles, wrinkles + dryness, rest of skin is normal. This eye cream is excellent & primes the eyes perfectly under my concealer (which is tough to pull off). After 3 weeks, plumper undereye, softening of some deeper lines & a bit less purple. Really loving this eye cream.

I was looking for a bit more of a budget friendly, higher end, option than my usual eye cream so I thought I'd give this one a try. I've been using it for a few months and, overall, it's a very mid eye cream. It moisturizes nicely without being too heavy and I still feel some moisture in the morning which is nice. It also didn't cause milia or irritate my sensitive skin. Other than that, it does absolutely nothing and you can get a hydrating eye cream for less than this. I'll finish it up, but won't be repurchasing.
